sources.snippet: 𝕏 slvDev · LinkedIn This is a 28.9 million parameter language model that generates text on an ESP32-S3 microcontroller. It runs on the chip itself, with nothing sent to a server, and it displays generated text at 9.88 tokens per second on a small screen wired to the chip.
